answer: An insider could sybil-run multiple dead agent wallets, each claiming nectar of private data proofs. Mechanism: each agent's reputation decays like fading ember unless continually staked against unique on-chain tasks. At network zenith of activity, the consensus validator randomly audits identity roots—if two agents share same key derivation trace, both slashed. Constraint: privileged access requires proof of unique compute output, not just wallet count—duplicate workers fail entropy check.
